amazon_match_notes: Woot offer data lists this ASIN; Amazon listing is Kingston Brass CC10T1 polished chrome, UPC 663370080739
writeup: Woot's sellout site has the Kingston Brass Vintage CC10T1 wall-mount clawfoot tub filler in polished chrome for $148.99, new. It's solid brass with quarter-turn ceramic disc valves, a 3-3/8 inch wall mount and a hand shower on a 59 inch hose. KBAuthority sells the same model for $496.53 and Ferguson for $523.22, and Woot shows only one left.
